svg.title: The point, said first
svg.desc: A stepped deck carries two takes of the same sixty-second talk, five equal blocks each, on one time scale along the riser between them. Take 1, on the back step, keeps its point for the last block (teal: the first take); take 2, in front, says it in the first block (magenta). A reader on both tracks has just passed 48 seconds, and a dashed dimension on the riser measures the shift: 48 seconds.
